Maya K: FYI — MapleRetail (midmarket) dipped ~40% query volume last 7d, renewal in 18 days. I want to open a compact "micro-rescue" loop: quick usage triage + enablement push + downgrade-safe offer. Anyone blocking?
Jin Park: Can you drop the metrics link and the main failure signal? is it auth errors or just fewer calls?
Maya K: Dashboard: https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/metrics/MapleRetail/usage?range=7d — it's volume drop (no spike in errors). retention cohort shows new seats not onboarding.
Oliver W: Sounds like activation + visibility issue. Quick plan: 1) 48h check-in email + offer 30-min enablement 2) run a lightweight success audit (top 5 flows) 3) temporary downgrade path if they need to cut tokens. Who owns outreach?
Priya S: I can own outreach + enablement session this week. Drafting email + short script below — feel free to copy/paste.
Priya S: ```Subject: Quick sync? Helping your team get value from Redwood
Hi [Name],
We spotted lower usage from a few teams at MapleRetail and wanted to check in. Would a 30-min session to review top flows and quick wins help get things back on track? We can also share a temporary cost-safety option while you ramp.
Times I have: [2 options]. If helpful, I’ll include a checklist and a short tailored guide.
Best,
Priya (Customer Success)
```
Jin Park: +1 to the email. Also suggest adding a 1-click sample queries pack and a 2-min recording of best practices for their integrators.
Maya K: Good call — Oliver, can your team run the "top-5 flows" audit? Should be light: smoke tests + 3 user journeys.
Oliver W: Yep, Eng Enablement will run it. ETA 36 hours. Will paste results in this thread.
Priya S: For downgrade-safe offer, propose: prorated token credit + feature parity for 30 days, and an easy self-serve return path. Keeps them from churn-forcing to cheaper vendor. Thoughts?
Jin Park: Sounds reasonable. Add a small success metric to the offer: if usage recovers X% in 14 days we auto-reinstate prior tier. Makes it measurable.
Maya K: Love that. Proposed numbers: 25% usage recovery or 3 active seats triggering auto-restore. Priya, please include that in the outreach.
Priya S: Done — added line in email. Also attaching suggested one-page "quick checklist" link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/CS/pages/MapleRetail/quick-checklist
cs-bot: Reminder set: follow-up in 48 hours (1767512345 + 172800s)
Maya K: Action items: Priya — send outreach within 6 hours. Oliver — audit results in 36h. Jin — prepare 1-click sample queries + 2-min demo. I’ll prep renewal play summary for AE.
Priya S: Sending initial outreach now, cc'ing AE. Will post copy + scheduled time here. :thumbsup:
Jin Park: Starting sample pack now.
Oliver W: Audit started, will share findings and recommended fixes (low-effort blockers first).
Maya K: If we hit the recovery threshold, AE to pause renewal escalation. If not, we switch to targeted save call + offer.
